name: quenching-align
description: The repository-wide align and the two knowledge fronts it conducts first: /quenching-align:align over every enabled module, the docs/ OKF bundle (/quenching-align:knowledge:*) and the .claude/ automation surface (/quenching-align:components:*). Fronts whose module is not enabled are reported not-installed, never invoked. Requires quenching-specs for cq.
